_readme: The writing<->mapmaking process as LAYERS — the registry behind the workflow-layers visualization (to be built at /workflow-layers in the encyclopedia). Each layer is one register of the edge compiler (see doc/book/LOOK_RULINGS.md P-1..P-7 and doc/HANDOFF_2026-07-16_the-edge-compiler.md). Layers are toggleable: 'enabled' turns a layer on/off in the displayed process; 'order' sorts the stack; add/remove = edit this file (the page should POST back here). direction: down = writing->space, up = space->writing, loop = closes the cycle.

layers.title: Sequence truth
layers.description: Each chapter's one-sentence truth and its place on the spine — what the maps must ultimately teach.

layers.title: Baseline beats & cast
layers.description: R-023: ask the concept what a plain tutorial minimally needs; beats cast with real artifacts, voltage added, the rest honored at depth.

layers.title: The walk & the turn (walked.md)
layers.description: The trench protocol: rulings are the source, prose is compiled. Walk at walking tempo; the turn carries the critique.

layers.title: The dwell register
layers.description: The walk learns to stop: inset long-takes at hero/counter/side stations, distilled from each map's critical.md and technical.md, provenance shown, reading time computed (P-6). Ruling pending.

layers.title: Text → desire targets
layers.description: P-6: the text is the clock. tutorial.md segments (idea/code/try) with computed loads compile into desire curves; TRY contracts a hand spike; the turn names the emphasis.

layers.title: Desire curves & dwell clock
layers.description: P-2/P-3/P-4: space as eye+hand desire over walk-time; per-artifact temporal footprints; cycles consummated in each artifact's currency; runtime = walk + sum of dwells (the sum, not the frame).

layers.title: Placement contracts (templates)
layers.description: P-7: the template decides where artifacts MAY stand. 23 principals + sub-templates + custom tile patterns, painted onto the grid; slots are the decided spots; empty slots are declared blanks.

layers.title: The composer (script → room)
layers.description: Experience-first composition: registers (arrival/promenade/close), the forward reading (axis discipline, dolly-in, scenes-not-rows), pins never dropped, FIT chasing the drawn/compiled desire targets.

layers.title: The generator box (14 strategies)
layers.description: The pearl factory: wfc, halls, rooms, ants, antrooms, wanghall, voronoi, rd, erosion, derive, flock, physarum, dla, lsystem — one door, named knobs.

layers.title: The experience judge
layers.description: Candidates scored in the experience domain: encounter order, the promise, the dolly-in, hero rank, desire-cycle completion. Pathfinder is the hard gate. 24-sequence tournament: 8 different champions.

layers.title: Observation (ride, captures, live window)
layers.description: gaze_ride reads a map as a token stream; headless captures make the pairs; the map-sim bridge shows any edit standing in a live Godot window within a second.

layers.title: Rulings (the loop closes)
layers.description: Judgments in language over captures and pages — archived verbatim, compiled into the contracts. Reader comments land in doc/book/reader_comments.json; the chapter reads itself aloud in registers (TTS, 1.5x default).

layers.title: Artifact staging (types + em-square)
layers.description: Optional layer: staging DNA types give each artifact its housing; the em-square its spatial contract. Improve the type, not the room.
